sara: Heads-up — noticed recurring preemptions in us-west2 over the last 48h, interactive sessions drop mid-request. stack traces show driver NMI + netlink errs, and we're seeing a handful of nodes with older driver versions causing bincompat issues.
omar: Can you paste a sample node log? also any pattern on instance types?
sara: paste: ```
Mar 18 02:14:22 node-042 kubelet: gpu-driver=510.47 kernel: nv_peer_memory: failed to register
Mar 18 02:14:22 node-042 network: link flapped eth0: carrier lost
Mar 18 02:14:23 pod session-ck: ERROR: grpc stream closed (code=13)
```
li: We also saw egress flange when we failover traffic across regions — routing queues spike and embeddings p95 goes way up during those migrations.
jess: TL;DR: fragmentation by driver + region constraints == lower effective capacity and higher tail. Proposal: region-level "hedge" pools with mixed-capacity tagging + a favored-slot scheduling heuristic for compatibility. Also introduce a short grace window for interactive KV transfer to avoid lost sessions on preempt.
omar: Agree on hedge pools. Important: make interactive higher priority than batch during off-peak, but give batch jobs reclaimable preemption credits so they don't starve.
sara: Draft policy snippet i sketched: ```yaml
pools:
  - name: region-hedge-transient
    region: us-west2
    instance_types: [a40-v2, a100-40, a100-80]
    driver_version_tag: 525
    preemptible: true
    min_hedge: 12
    grace_seconds: 60
    traffic_shift_policy: staggered-drain
```
infra-bot: heads-up: creating a new pool will trigger a rolling node bootstrap; estimated disruption window 45m if started during low-traffic 02:00-04:00 UTC.
li: Question: baseline driver 525 ok? some quant kernels in the catalog require 535. we shouldn't block those models.
jess: Keep a tiny dedicated 535 pool for those models and route via model tags + scheduler constraints. We'll advertise fallback compatibility: if no exact driver match, try compat-slot with 200ms scheduling penalty.
omar: Scheduler note: fragmentation increases scheduling latency if we insist on exact matches. Suggest favored_slot heuristic: try exact match for 200ms, then compat match, else spill to reserved capacity. That keeps tail bounded.
sara: Also adding a KV cache handshake: on preempt, attempt a 60s cache transfer to target node before killing process. For interactive sessions that reduces recompute.
jess: I'll own rollout + runbook. Action items: add metrics (interactive_preempt_rate, fallback_latency_p95, scheduling_delay_p50/p95), update scheduler to honor favored_slot, and create terraform for region-hedge-transient pool.
sara: i've scheduled a 3h deep-dive Fri 09:30 PT to finalize config and rollout steps. tagging infra owners: @omar @li @jess
omar: ack
